name: alert
useFor: Use default or info for a fact the person should know (The vault is zero-knowledge), warning for something to act on now (Copy this API key now, with the reason in AlertAction), success for something done, destructive for a failure, muted for a panel that introduces a setup step (Initialize vault). Lead with a filled Phosphor glyph. An alert is as wide as its words and centered; in a dialog, form or aside it fills the width.
constraints: A dark or saturated alert background
More than one alert stacked for one message
A stretched alert in the middle of a page
source: Console Alert theme; Figma 427:2715: Vault (Initialize vault, zero-knowledge note), Modal - Created (Copy this API key now)
title: Alert
description: The pale cyan info note (the default), the sand warning, the pale green success, the red-edged error, and the lilac vault box.
